46075-motor-matt-or-the-king-of-the-whee.title: Of The Wheel
46075-motor-matt-or-the-king-of-the-whee.creator: Stanley R. Matthews.
46075-motor-matt-or-the-king-of-the-whee.description: A book by Stanley R. Matthews.. "Yes, you do," panted the boy, swinging in toward the gate and coming to a halt. "Sure you know me." Catching hold of the gate-palings he steadied himself and grinned in a manner which he must have thought engaging. "Why, you've seen me a dozen times, anyhow.

arxiv-2101-04209.title: PyHealth: A Python Library for Health Predictive Models Thanks: Work initialized while at IQVIA.
arxiv-2101-04209.creator: Yue Zhao zhaoy@cmu.edu, Zhi Qiao * zhi.qiao@iqvia.com, Cao Xiao cao.xiao@iqvia.com, Lucas M. Glass lucas.glass@iqvia.com, Jimeng Sun jimeng@illinois.edu
arxiv-2101-04209.description: Abstract Despite the explosion of interest in healthcare AI research, the reproducibility and benchmarking of those research works are often limited due to the lack of standard benchmark datasets and diverse evaluation metrics. To address this reproducibility challenge, we develop PyHealth , an open-source Python toolbox for developing various predictive models on healthcare data.

arxiv-2206-12619.title: Lorentz violating inflation and the Swampland
arxiv-2206-12619.creator: Oem Trivedi
arxiv-2206-12619.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Oem Trivedi. The swampland conjectures from String theory have had very interesting implications for cosmology and particularly for Inflation. It has been shown that the single field inflationary models in a GR based cosmology are in unavoidable tensions with these conjectures and so it becomes interesting to see whether there is a way to overcome the issues of the swampland and single field inflation in an essentially GR based cosmology.

arxiv-2303-02139.title: Data Association Aware POMDP Planning with Hypothesis Pruning Performance Guarantees
arxiv-2303-02139.creator: Moran Barenboim, Idan Lev-Yehudi, Vadim Indelman
arxiv-2303-02139.description: Abstract Autonomous agents that operate in the real world must often deal with partial observability, which is commonly modeled as partially observable Markov decision processes (POMDPs). However, traditional POMDP models rely on the assumption of complete knowledge of the observation source, known as fully observable data association.

arxiv-2310-01408.title: Generalized Animal Imitator: Agile Locomotion with Versatile Motion Prior
arxiv-2310-01408.creator: Ruihan Yang, Zhuoqun Chen, Jianhan Ma, Chongyi Zheng, Yiyu Chen, Quan Nguyen, Xiaolong Wang
arxiv-2310-01408.description: Abstract The agility of animals, particularly in complex activities such as running, turning, jumping, and backflipping, stands as an exemplar for robotic system design. Transferring this suite of behaviors to legged robotic systems introduces essential inquiries: How can a robot learn multiple locomotion behaviors simultaneously? How can the robot execute these tasks with a smooth transition?

arxiv-2602-03738.title: Emergent structures in coupled opinion and network dynamics
arxiv-2602-03738.creator: Andrew Nugent, Carmen Calatayud Fernández, Susana N. Gomes
arxiv-2602-03738.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Andrew Nugent, Carmen Calatayud Fernández, Susana N. Gomes. This paper investigates a model of opinion formation on an adaptive social network, consisting of a system of coupled ordinary differential equations for individuals’ opinions and corresponding network edge weights. A key driver of the system’s behaviour is the form of the interaction function, which determines the strength of interactions based on the distance between individuals’ opinions and appears in both opinion and network dynamics.

britannica-1911-gordon-alexander.title: Gordon, Alexander (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-gordon-alexander.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-gordon-alexander.description: Article 'Gordon, Alexander' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 12), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. distinguished himself in classics at Aberdeen University, and to have made a living at first by teaching languages and music. When still young he travelled abroad, probably in the capacity of tutor. He returned to Scotland previous to 1726, and devoted himself to antiquarian work. In 1726 appeared the Itinerarium Septentrionale, his greatest and best-known work.

pmc-10546239.creator: Rohit Vashisht, Ayan Patel, Lisa Dahm, Cora Han, Kathryn E. Medders, Robert Mowers, Carrie L. Byington, Suneil K. Koliwad, Atul J. Butte

pmc-10589854.title: A model to explain smokeless tobacco consumption in adults: A grounded theory study
pmc-10589854.creator: Esmaeil Fattahi, Mahnaz Solhi, Seyed Saeed Hashemi Nazari, Hadis Barati, Fardin Mehrabian, Zahra Sadat Manzari, Iraj Zareban, Abolhasan Afkar
pmc-10589854.description: IntroductionSmokeless tobacco use remains a significant public health concern, necessitating the acquisition of comprehensive and extensive data to effectively address and control its consumption. Understanding the underlying patterns of consumption is crucial for this purpose.ObjectiveThis study aimed to develop a model that explains smokeless tobacco consumption among adults in the southeastern province of Iran, specifically in the city of Chabahar.

pmc-10654138.title: Life-cycle cost analysis (LCCA): Comparing outputs for bibliographic coupling and citation links
pmc-10654138.creator: Vítor João Pereira Domingues Martinho
pmc-10654138.description: The life-cycle cost analysis (LCCA) is an important tool that jointly with the environmental and social life-cycle assessment provides relevant insights into studies about sustainability. This is true in the different economic sectors and social dimensions. Nonetheless, the literature shows that there is a field to be explored about this topic through bibliometric analysis.

pmc-11652036.title: Identification of vessels encapsulating tumor clusters in solitary hepatocellular carcinoma via imaging biomarkers in preoperative contrast-enhanced magnetic resonance imaging
pmc-11652036.creator: Zongwen Li, Wenlong Song, Jiayan Zhang, Qian Li, Zuhua Song, Xiaofang Ren, Youjia Wen, Xintong Li, Hui Yao, Yunjing Gao, Zhuoyue Tang
pmc-11652036.description: BackgroundThe value of Liver Imaging Reporting and Data System (LI-RADS) radiological features and tumor three-dimensional volumetric quantification in preoperative magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) for predicting the vessels encapsulating tumor clusters (VETC) pattern of solitary hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) is unknown. This study aimed to assess the value of these indicators for predicting the VETC pattern of solitary HCC.

pmc-12617652.title: Responding to the call: Population affinity estimation in a South African forensic context of identification - are we helping or harming?
pmc-12617652.creator: Victoria E. Gibbon, Athi Baliso, Laura J. Heathfield
pmc-12617652.description: There is growing momentum in forensic anthropology to move away from using socially ascribed racial groups in analysis and reporting. This study evaluated whether and how anthropological estimation of population-affinity influences identification outcomes in forensic cases processed at the Forensic Anthropology Cape Town (FACT) laboratory in South Africa. A total of 172 cases (174 individuals) were examined.

uslaw-usc-t25-s401.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t25-s401.description: United States Code, Title 25 (Indians); Chapter 12 (Lease, Sale, Or Surrender Of Allotted Or Unallotted Lands). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The Secretary of the Interior is authorized to lease for mining purposes lands reserved from allotment to be used as a cemetery and not needed for that purpose, and lands reserved for school and agency purposes in the Kaw Reservation.
